narrative.overview: Glitter is a searchable resource directory with a peer graph view. White canvas, square institutional rails, compact controls and a persistent status line make it operational from the first viewport. Search and filters lead discovery; reviewed, evidence-backed relationships explain connections while gaps stay visible.

rules.name: The Discovery-First Rule
rules.body: Search and filters must reveal useful records within seconds; the graph is a peer view, never the only route to content.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Use structure and tonal layering, not desktop card shadows.

rules.name: The Square-Rail Rule
rules.body: Never round structural containers, navigation cells, search bands, toolbars or primary actions.

dos: Do open on search and filter results with the evidence inspector available immediately.
Do distinguish source record, retrieval date, source metadata licence and unknown resource licence.
Do preserve square rails, hard rules, IBM Plex Sans and the status line.
donts: Don't force users through the graph when a list and filters answer the question faster.
Don't leave selected-edge meaning in hover-only tooltips.
Don't infer resource licence from source metadata licence.
Don't introduce rounded panels or desktop card shadows.
